anomalies.observed: On the MCU sheet the USB-C receptacle J14 VBUS pin is wired to the global label 'VBUS' (the same net that is the TPS2121RUXR U4 OUT pin 1 on the Power sheet), while U4 IN2 (pin 2) is on the '+5V' net. The '+5V' net therefore has no connection to the USB connector, and the mux output rail 'VBUS' is tied directly to a USB VBUS pin.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec, all USB-C VBUS pins must be on the '+5V' net that feeds U5/TPS2121 IN2, and the mux OUT must be on a separate internal 'VBUS' rail: 'J12 ... VBUS pins (A4/A9/B4/B9) -> +5V net -> U5 pin 2/2_1 (IN2)' and 'note this net is named VBUS in the netlist but is distinct from the USB +5V net upstream of the mux.'

evidence.quote: J12 ... VBUS pins (A4/A9/B4/B9) -> +5V net -> U5 pin 2/2_1 (IN2)
note this net is named VBUS in the netlist but is distinct from the USB +5V net upstream of the mux
mcu.kicad_sch: J14 VBUS pin carries global label 'VBUS'; power.kicad_sch: U4 pin1 OUT = VBUS, U4 pin2 IN2 = +5V

anomalies.impact: The autoswitching power-mux architecture is defeated: USB no longer feeds IN2 (board cannot be powered from USB through the mux), and the mux output is shorted to the USB VBUS pin, so a connected barrel-jack 12 V would appear directly on the USB-C VBUS line, risking damage to a host and preventing seamless switchover.

anomalies.observed: The WS2812B status LED D5 data input is driven by net 'NET0008', which appears only at D5 on the MCU sheet; no ESP32-C3 (U11) pin carries NET0008, so the LED's DIN line is floating.
anomalies.expected: The spec lists a single onboard WS2812B status LED driven by the MCU ('a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1)', firmware led.rs sets colors), so its data input must connect to an ESP32 GPIO.

evidence.quote: a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1)
mcu.kicad_sch: D5 WS2812B DIN = NET0008; NET0008 not present on any U11 pin

anomalies.impact: The onboard status LED can never be updated by firmware; all LED-based status reporting is lost.

parsed.summary: The drawing shows the USB-C VBUS pin tied to the mux-output 'VBUS' net instead of the separate '+5V' net that feeds the TPS2121RUXR IN2, merging the two rails the spec requires to be distinct and breaking the power-mux arbitration; additionally the WS2812B status LED data line (NET0008) is left unconnected to the MCU.
